about.title: A complete approach to education
about.paragraph1: Zenit School provides a structured learning process, with clear academic standards and continuous attention to student progress.
about.paragraph2: Teaching combines theoretical knowledge with practical work, technology and physical activity, helping students develop critical thinking, responsibility and confidence.
about.highlightText: Coding, technology projects and practical activities give students opportunities to investigate, collaborate and apply their knowledge to real challenges.
